knowledgeHub.title: Store Knowledge Hub
knowledgeHub.subtitle: Manage approved guidance that the system can use for customer support and store operations.
knowledgeHub.documentsHint: The system only uses approved guidance while it is in effect.
knowledgeHub.empty: No guidance yet. Create the first draft to begin.
knowledgeHub.selectDocument: Choose guidance on the left to see its content and usage status.

emptyStatus.approved: No guidance is currently in use.
emptyStatus.draft: No guidance is waiting for approval.

knowledgeHub.guidanceContent: Guidance employees and agents will follow
knowledgeHub.approvalExplanation: Only guidance marked “In use” can support an agent response.
knowledgeHub.retireReason: A manager stopped this version from being used in the Knowledge Hub.
knowledgeHub.testSearchHint: Enter a customer-like question to check which approved guidance the system finds.
knowledgeHub.searchPlaceholder: For example: Has the order been paid?
knowledgeHub.noMatch: No matching approved guidance was found. The agent will ask an employee to check manually.
knowledgeHub.createHint: Guidance is saved as a draft. A manager must approve it before an agent may use it.

fields.title: Clear guidance name
fields.contentHint: Use short paragraphs, with one rule or concrete handling instruction in each paragraph.

sources.title: Connected knowledge sources
sources.subtitle: Connect documents so the system can prepare sourced guidance for manager approval.
sources.simpleSubtitle: When you check for updates, changed content becomes a draft for a manager to review.
sources.empty: No document is connected yet. Choose one to prepare the first draft.
sources.connectionErrorHint: The document could not be read. Check its address, approved host, and text or Markdown format.
sources.googleShareHint: Share this document with {{email}} as a Viewer, then paste its link above.
sources.googleNotReadyHint: Connect a Google account at the top of this page before choosing a document.

oauth.connectedAs: Using {{email}}. The system can only read files you explicitly choose.
oauth.connectHint: Sign in to Google and choose which documents the system may read.
oauth.platformNotReady: The deployer has not completed the Google OAuth application setup for this store.
oauth.pickerHint: Select Choose from Google Drive. Google grants access only to the file selected with {{email}}.
oauth.connectedMessage: Google Drive is connected. You can now choose documents directly.
oauth.cancelledMessage: Google connection was closed or declined. Nothing was changed.
oauth.disconnectedMessage: Google was disconnected and the stored access grant was removed.
oauth.connectError: Google sign-in could not start. Check the connector setup.
oauth.disconnectError: Google could not be disconnected. Try again.
oauth.pickerError: Google Drive could not be opened. Reconnect the account and try again.
oauth.disconnectConfirmation: The encrypted refresh token will be deleted and Google revocation will be requested. Google sources stop updating until you reconnect.

sources.createHint: Just choose a document. The system fills its name, detects its type, and creates only a draft for manager approval.

automatic.supportedHint: If you choose another type, the system identifies it and explains the problem before saving.
automatic.noSelection: No document selected. Its name and type will be filled automatically.
automatic.unsupportedTitle: This document type is not supported
automatic.unsupportedHint: {{name}} is not a Google Doc, Google Sheet, TXT, Markdown, or CSV file. Choose another document.

sources.safetyHint: The system checks the source and creates a new draft only when its content changes. An authorized manager must review and approve that draft before agents can use it.

fields.name: Source name
fields.urlHint: The host must be approved by the server administrator. HTML pages and private network addresses are rejected.
fields.googleUrlHint: Paste the sharing link from Google Docs, Google Sheets, or a Drive file.

types.googleDrive: Text, Markdown, or CSV file on Google Drive

messages.connected: Source connection saved. Check it to create the first draft.
messages.createError: The Google document could not be connected. Check its access permission and select it again.
messages.synced: Source checked and a new knowledge draft was created for review.
messages.unchanged: Source checked. Its content has not changed, so no duplicate draft was created.
messages.syncError: The source could not be synchronized. Review the connection status for details.

messages.created: Draft saved. Agents cannot use this guidance until it is approved.
messages.approved: Approved. Agents can now find and cite this guidance.
messages.retired: Use stopped. Agents will no longer use this version.
messages.actionError: The action could not be completed. Check the information and try again.
messages.searchError: Guidance search is unavailable right now. Please try again.

supportDesk.title: Customer Support
supportDesk.subtitle: Choose a request, check the order, then prepare a response for the customer.
supportDesk.completedCount: {{count}} requests have been checked by an employee
supportDesk.emptyOpen: No customers are waiting for a response.
supportDesk.emptyCompleted: No requests have been finished yet.
supportDesk.selectRequest: Choose a customer question on the left to review and handle it.
supportDesk.customerQuestion: What the customer needs help with
supportDesk.due: The customer should receive a response before {{time}}
supportDesk.suggestedReply: Response being prepared for the customer
supportDesk.replyEditHint: Check the order information, make the response clear, then save your review.
supportDesk.replyLockedHint: Select “Take and start replying” to edit this response.
supportDesk.replyCompletedHint: This is the response an employee reviewed and saved.
supportDesk.sourcesDescription: This shows which store guidance supports the response.
supportDesk.noSources: The system did not find matching guidance. Check the order information carefully before responding.
supportDesk.sourceName: Store guidance for answering order-status questions
supportDesk.notSent: Not sent: saving only records that you checked the response. It does not message the customer.
supportDesk.releaseDescription: The request will return to the queue for another employee. Any changes you typed but did not save will be discarded.
supportDesk.transferManager: Ask a manager to handle it
supportDesk.transferTitle: Ask a manager to handle this request
supportDesk.transferDescription: Use this when the customer needs an exception or a decision outside your authority. The request will be assigned to a manager.
supportDesk.transferReason: What does the manager need to help with?
supportDesk.transferPlaceholder: For example: the customer requests an exception outside store policy...
supportDesk.claimedByOther: This request is being handled by another employee.
supportDesk.transferred: A manager is now responsible for this request.
supportDesk.draftCompleted: Your checked response was saved. The system has not sent it to the customer.
supportDesk.requestTaken: The request is assigned to you. You can edit the response now.
supportDesk.requestReleased: The request was returned to the queue for another employee.
supportDesk.requestTransferred: The request was assigned to a manager.
supportDesk.replyRequired: Enter the response you plan to give the customer before saving.
supportDesk.loadError: Customer requests could not be loaded. Please try again.
supportDesk.actionError: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
supportDesk.simulatorDescription: Choose a recent order and write a customer question. The system will create a real support task for an employee to review.
supportDesk.simulatorQuestionPlaceholder: For example: Has my order been paid and when will it be delivered?
supportDesk.simulatorSafetyNote: Test channel only: this does not contact a real customer and the agent cannot send a reply automatically.
supportDesk.simulatorCreated: The test customer message created a support request.
supportDesk.simulatorOrderRequired: Choose an order that belongs to a customer.
supportDesk.simulatorConversationDescription: This shows the customer message and any reply an employee explicitly confirmed.

supportDesk.simulatorReplySent: The checked response was sent to the internal test chat.
supportDesk.simulatorAlreadySent: Sent to the internal test chat after employee confirmation.

aiProviders.subtitle: Choose an AI service to search approved store guidance and prepare replies for employees.

aiProviders.apiKeyEditHint: Leave blank to keep the current key ending in {{hint}}.

aiProviders.modelHint: The list is loaded automatically from the provider for this API key.

aiProviders.modelWaitingForKey: Enter the API key to load available models automatically.
aiProviders.saved: The AI connection was stored securely.
aiProviders.saveError: The connection could not be saved. Check the API key and try again.
aiProviders.disconnectError: The service could not be disconnected.
